issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release v2.0.0 §5.5.7 toQuantity([unit]) / convertsToQuantity([unit]) and §5.5.8 toString() / convertsToString()
issues.evidence: Fresh FP-08 HISTORIAN probe: resource path value is Quantity returns true, but native value.toQuantity() returned empty and value.convertsToQuantity() false; both native and fallback value.toString()/convertsToString() returned empty/false. Fallback also accepted invalidQuantity.value='abc' as a Quantity and converted 5 mg to 0 g instead of 0.005 g.
issues.root_cause: Native conversion functions only recognized literal FPValue::Quantity, not Quantity-like JsonVal path values; Python fallback ResourceNode Quantity parsing was not strict and toString() did not use converted Quantity values. Python mass conversion also rounded g/mg unit conversion to an integer.
issues.resolution: Implemented strict Quantity materialization for native JsonVal and Python fallback ResourceNode/dict values at FP-08 conversion/stringification boundaries; fixed fallback g/mg fractional conversion and native Quantity JSON escaping/ordinary fractional serialization.
issues.verified_in: Fresh FP-08 HISTORIAN probe 39/39 with 0 native/fallback mismatches; pytest test_conversion_parity.py 18 passed; native fhirpath sqllogictest 424 assertions passed; full conformance 2822/2822.
